description: Persona A: SF visitor staying in Hayes Valley. Museum-and-park day on an $85 budget, hard dinner meetup in Palo Alto 19:00-21:00, back by 23:45. The initial plan packs pricey museums and blows the budget, so the first audit fails and the repair loop re-ranks under a max_total_cost constraint - the core demo.
